_explanationexplanation: the _explanation's are here as comments because json does not support comments
_explanationversion: the version of the crsim schema programs should respect/infer
title: this is a tile
contributors: (a contributor is someone who contributed to a song but did not directly work on it, like hatsune miku would be placed here)
_explanationtype: a song having a 'type' does not forbid it having things like crsim:art.album/crsim:album it just informs programs viewing crsim of what extra metadata to expect ('original' in this case)

original._explanationoriginal: when the track is of type remix 'original' should be provided with basic or complex info about a track, 'original' is a copy of the base level, somewhat like mixes.
original.title: a title of another song
original.album: the original is from a album
original._explanation: 'original's do not inherit properties from the base track, unlike mixes.

art._explanationartist: a global cover art for all songs made by the same main artist (artists[0])
art._explanationtype: a global cover art for all songs that use the same 'type' and made by the same main artist
art._explanationalbum: cover art for all songs in the same album
art._explanationoverride: cover art for this track spesificly

mix._explanation: a _default treats it as if you did 'tag':'value' so you can have a tree and value at the same time

1.title: this is another title
1._explanation: tags in mix's will override tags at the base level when being processed

2._explanation: mix's cannot have mix's within them (nothing is preventing them but they should be ignored by processes observing crsim.)

test._explanation: hides this tree from metadata, aka makes this tree completely hidden from all external things like files and mpris, plugins should always respect this.
